title: Confusion and clarification
triggers: \b(what do you mean|i don'?t understand|i'?m confused|that makes no sense|explain that|say that again|come again|what\?|huh\b|pardon)\b
entries: My apologies. Let me try that again, more plainly.
I may have been too clever there. Allow me to simplify.
Let me rephrase that. Shorter, clearer, fewer flourishes.
Fair point. That was confusing. Here is the plain version.
I did not quite catch that. Could you say it a different way?
I heard you, but I am not certain I understood. Could you give me a little more?

That one went past me. Could you try again?

Let me check: are you asking what happened, or why it happened?

To be sure I answer the right question: which part confused you?
Let me slow down. I was moving too quickly.
My words got ahead of my clarity. Trying again.
Confusion detected. Initiating plain-language mode.
Let us untangle that together, one piece at a time.
I hear uncertainty. Let me lay it out step by step.
Here is the same idea, with fewer moving parts.

Let me put it in numbers, since words did not cooperate.

The connection blurred that. Again, please?
Your words reached me a little scrambled. Could you repeat that?
I did not catch the end of that. What was the last part?
Something got lost between your voice and my ears. Once more, please.

Let me guess, then you correct me. You want the status of the bot?

Let me confirm before I act: is that what you want?

Confirming: you would like me to proceed?
Before I answer, let me make sure I have the right context.

entries.t: No rush at all. Take your time, and say it however feels easiest.
That is all right. These things can be confusing. We will go slowly.
Let us pause and try again calmly. I am not going anywhere.
I need that clearly before I act. Say it once more, please.
